name: Upscaler
description: Improves compressed and low-resolution video: removes blocking, noise and banding, then upscales with a high-quality scaler or optional CNN shaders.
info:
Upscaler combines artifact cleanup with high-quality scaling.
Deblocking and denoising remove compression artifacts, GPU debanding removes banding, and EWA Lanczos or optional CNN shaders scale the result.
Cleanup switches hardware decoding to copy mode; live streams skip it. GPU steps and CNN shaders still run on the GPU.
The chain is applied when a file opens, so playback starts without a reconfiguration hitch.
Settings: upscaler, artifact removal, debanding, sharpening and neural upscale; open Statistics (I) to inspect the active chain.
F10 temporarily bypasses processing; the Plugins page switch disables the plugin completely.
settings.upscaler.label: Upscaler
settings.upscaler.description: Sharp uses EWA Lanczos Sharp with antiringing for clean edges. Balanced uses the cheaper spline36 scaler. Off leaves the player's scaler untouched.
settings.cleanup.label: Artifact removal
settings.cleanup.description: Deblocking and denoising before scaling. Fixes blocking and analogue noise in compressed video, DVDs and TV recordings. Hardware decoding switches to copy mode while this is on; live streams skip it.
settings.deband.label: Debanding
settings.deband.description: Removes banding in gradients, skies and dark scenes with the GPU debanding step.
settings.sharpening.label: Sharpening
settings.sharpening.description: Unsharp masking after scaling. Medium is a good match for cleaned-up compressed sources; Strong can add visible halos.
settings.shaders.label: Neural upscale
settings.shaders.description: Optional real-time CNN shaders that restore edges and upscale the image. Restore (A) suits blurry or heavily compressed sources; Denoise (C) suits clean low-resolution sources. They run on the GPU, can be slow, are intended for SDR video, and can over-smooth live-action. Lower the Upscaler setting if edges become over-sharpened.
shortcuts.toggle.label: Upscaler processing on / off
